The large field set off at a terrific pace and among the first 6 were soon seen Foord (Brighton), who won for the fourth time, Ernie Earl (Hercules), Tony Weckes-Pearson (Blackheath) and our own Charlie Dabbs.

In no way deterred by the reputations enjoyed by his opponents, Charlie Dabbs clung to the redoubtable Pirie and title-holder Ernie Earl sufficiently well to gain a notable 3rd place in the 3 miles, clocking 14:21.8---a personal best.
In the Surrey '6' at Wimbledon Park,May 10th, Ernie Earl (Hercules) and Chas. Dabbs fought out an extremely good race for twenty three laps.

Ernie Earl that old battler for Hercules was in great form and took his club into the lead once more and following him was a fight between Coventry, Poly and Manchester which resulted in Poly taking 2nd place through an excellent run by Campbell.
